t: The one time he opened the floor completely
a: مَنْ أَحَبَّ أَنْ يَسْأَلَ عَنْ شَىْءٍ فَلْيَسْأَلْ، فَلاَ تَسْأَلُونِي عَنْ شَىْءٍ إِلاَّ أَخْبَرْتُكُمْ مَا دُمْتُ فِي مَقَامِي هَذَا
p: Man aḥabba an yasʾala ʿan shayʾin fa-lyasʾal. Fa-lā tasʾalūnī ʿan shayʾin illā akhbartukum mā dumtu fī maqāmī hādhā
m: Whoever wants to ask about anything, let him ask. You will not ask me about anything without my telling you, as long as I am standing in this place of mine.
